mapper.select: SELECT C.COURSE_NO, C.COURSE_NAME, START_PLACE.PLACE_NO AS START_PLACE_NO, START_PLACE.PLACE_NAME AS START_PLACE_NAME, END_PLACE.PLACE_NO AS END_PLACE_NO, END_PLACE.PLACE_NAME AS END_PLACE_NAME, C.ESTIMATED_TIME, C.DESCRIPTION FROM COURSE C JOIN PLACE START_PLACE ON START_PLACE.PLACE_NO = C.START_PLACE JOIN PLACE END_PLACE ON END_PLACE.PLACE_NO = C.END_PLACE WHERE C.ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY C.COURSE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COURSE C JOIN PLACE START_PLACE ON START_PLACE.PLACE_NO = C.START_PLACE JOIN PLACE END_PLACE ON END_PLACE.PLACE_NO = C.END_PLACE WHERE C.ACTIVE = 'Y'
SELECT COURSE_NO , START_PLACE , END_PLACE , COURSE_NAME , ESTIMATED_TIME , DESCRIPTION FROM COURSE WHERE ACTIVE = 'Y' AND COURSE_NO = #{courseNo}

SELECT W.WAYPOINT_NO , W.COURSE_NO , W.PLACE_NO , W.WAYPOINT_SEQUENCE , P.PLACE_NAME , P.X_AXIS , P.Y_AXIS , PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME AS IMAGE_URL FROM COURSE C JOIN COURSE_WAYPOINT W ON C.COURSE_NO = W.COURSE_NO JOIN PLACE P ON W.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO LEFT JOIN PLACE_IMG PI ON P.PLACE_NO = PI.PLACE_NO AND PI.IMG_ORDER = 1 WHERE W.COURSE_NO = #{courseNo} AND C.ACTIVE = 'Y' AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY W.WAYPOINT_SEQUENCE ASC

SELECT P.PLACE_NO , P.PLACE_NAME , P.X_AXIS , P.Y_AXIS , PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME AS IMAGE_URL , T.TAG_CONTENT FROM PLACE P JOIN PLACE_TAG PT ON P.PLACE_NO = PT.PLACE_NO JOIN TAG T ON PT.TAG_NO = T.TAG_NO LEFT JOIN PLACE_IMG PI ON P.PLACE_NO = PI.PLACE_NO AND PI.IMG_ORDER = 1 WHERE P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T.TAG_CONTENT IN
#{tag}
